source: PHC Core Rules v1.0, Map objects and points of interest (provisional, item 59)

items.name: Crate
items.text: Crates, sandbags or low wreckage. It gives half cover and can be shot to pieces.

items.name: Low wall
items.text: Waist-high masonry or plating. It gives half cover.

items.name: Pillar
items.text: A pillar, pylon or hull plate. It gives full cover and blocks sight.

items.name: Barricade
items.text: Something built to keep people out: it blocks the way and blocks sight. Break it, climb it or find another way round.

items.name: Door
items.text: A closed door blocks movement and sight. Opening or closing it costs 1 AP in a fight. A locked door needs a key, a check or a lot of damage.

items.name: Hole
items.text: A pit, shaft or breach that nobody can walk across. The Narrator decides what happens to someone who falls in.

items.name: Trap
items.text: Hidden until someone spots it: a character within {=trap.detect_range} tiles spots it if 10 + their Vigilance modifier reaches its TN. Stepping on it sets it off and deals its damage. Disarming it takes a check.

items.name: Fire
items.text: Burning ground. Anyone who starts their turn in it takes {=hazard.damage} damage.

items.name: Toxic spill
items.text: Spilled chemicals or bad mana. Anyone who starts their turn in it takes {=hazard.damage} damage.

items.name: Explosive barrel
items.text: It gives half cover until it is destroyed. At 0 HP it explodes: {=explodes.damage} damage to everyone within {=explodes.radius} tiles, and it leaves fire behind.

items.name: Rubble
items.text: What is left of broken cover. It slows movement and gives no cover.

items.name: Container
items.text: A locker, chest or cargo box. The Narrator decides what is inside, and opening a locked one takes a check.

items.name: Terminal
items.text: A console or machine. Using it takes a check, usually Improvisation.

items.name: Lamp
items.text: A work lamp, flare or brazier. It lights the tiles within {=light} of it, so darkness doesn't halve sight there. Shoot it out to bring the dark back.

items.name: Point of interest
items.text: Something worth a closer look. Examine it, and the Narrator tells you the ways to deal with it.

items.name: Way out
items.text: A way off this map. The Narrator decides where it leads.

items.name: Camera
items.text: It watches a cone of the room. A character with the Slicer trait can blind it, and shooting it puts it out.

items.name: Alarm panel
items.text: It raises the alarm when tripped. A character with the Slicer trait can silence it.

items.name: Emplaced turret
items.text: A fixed gun on a mount. The Narrator runs it as an enemy, and a character with the Slicer trait can take it over.

items.name: RAISE wall
items.text: A wall of packed bots raised by a RAISE Sigil. It blocks movement and sight and has 30 HP. It crumbles after 3 rounds plus the caster's Sigil duration bonus, and the word NULL unmakes it at once.

items.name: Cache
items.text: A crate, a body or a locker with things inside. Search it from the next tile for 1 AP to take everything. A locked one has to be opened first, through one of its approaches.

items.name: Sigil mark
items.text: A Sigil word drawn into the world long ago: carved on a door or a ruin, a Keystone, a warding post, an old plate fixed to a wall. Investigate it from the next tile for 2 AP with Acuity or Rumination; the TN depends on its age and damage. A success copies the word for you to study, and a critical success teaches it to you outright.

items.name: Pile
items.text: Things lying on the ground: dropped magazines, loose rounds, weapons and anything else that fell there. Each tile has one pile. Picking up costs 1 AP, from your own tile or the next one, and takes everything unless you untick some of it. You see a pile when your party can see its tile.
